details: Beginning study of toy_variance, toy_reduce_partial, and row-wise reduction ops as precedents for RMSNorm

Read toy_variance, toy_reduce_partial, toy_tilize_untilize, width_split, tile_reorder, row_reduce_accumulate fully. Key finding: SUPPORTED/INPUT_TAGGERS/validate/default_compute_kernel_config are the registry-model contract from tt_metal/third_party/tt_ops_code_gen/eval/op_template.py and eval/golden_tests/rms_norm/axes.py (imports rms_norm, INPUT_TAGGERS, default_compute_kernel_config from ttnn.operations.rms_norm) -- neither toy op implements this contract (both are single-core toys with no validate/SUPPORTED). No op_design.md exists anywhere in repo; template is references/op-design-template.md (no Blocking Model section in the template itself) but agents/incremental-planner.md mandates a Blocking Model section as first required section with exact table spec. Reported findings to parent.
